sloka: गम्यतां सौम्य किष्किन्धां दुराधर्षां सुरासुरैः ।पालयस्व सहामात्यो राज्यं निहतकण्टकम् ।। ७.४०.२ ॥
transliteration: gamyatāṁ saumya kiṣkindhāṁ durādharṣāṁ surāsuraiḥ ।pālayasva sahāmātyo rājyaṁ nihatakaṇṭakam ।। 7.40.2 ॥

translations.english: O gentle one, go to Kishkindha, which is unassailable even by gods and demons, and rule your kingdom with your ministers, having removed all its enemies.
